text:
Maria: Morning team — quick async standup for the midday push.
Maria: What I did: finalised the embed-cache spec, updated rollout doc, and demoed canary plan to Eng leads.
Maria: Blockers: waiting on final signoff for model-routing defaults from infra; need decision on fallback priority.
Maria: Today: merge spec PR, schedule smoke test run, and chase signoff.
Ajay: Reviewed spec and left a few inline comments on the routing priority table. Will open a small follow-up PR for the config tests: https://github.com/redwood-repos/infra/pull/458
Ajay: Blocker: CI flaky on integration job `serve_integration` — looks like a race around cache warmup + kv-cache eviction.
Lena: Working on embeddings perf harness; can reproduce the CI flake locally with `./tools/run_integration --seed=42`. I'll push a debug build later today.
Tom: Quick heads-up — deploy-bot scheduled a canary window at 14:00 PST, need a smoke checklist and someone to own the post-canary rollback criterias.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-17 14:00 PST. Trigger: user/2966543210. (automated)
Maria: @Tom can you add the smoke checklist to the runbook? Suggested minimal checklist: 
```
smoke-checklist:
  - qps sanity: compare to baseline (±15%)
  - p95 latency < 200ms for generation route
  - KV cache hitrate not decreased >5%
  - fallback route returns valid output for sample prompt set
```
Tom: Added to runbook and flagged the smoke owner role to @Ajay for this canary.
Ajay: I'll run the smoke tests and collect traces. If CI flake persists, I'll gate the merge behind the debug fix.
Lena: Pinged @Nina for capacity check. Also I'll attach perf logs to the PR once I repro the flake.
Nina: Capacity check: Dedicated pool has headroom for the canary at 1x; recommend burst to 1.5x for the first 15 minutes. Also confirm scaling policy is set to allow short spikes.
Maria: Great — I'll update the rollout doc with burst recommendation and request final signoff from @VP-Product.
Ajay: Small note — added TODO for a regression test that asserts cache-warmup order; will push before EOD.
Maria: Thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker, drop a quick ping here and mark the PR with `needs-triage`. :thumbsup:
